**1 — Scene:** A cafeteria-style meal: rice with creamy curry, meatballs, mixed vegetables, a brownie, and a dark drink. I count all dishes on the tray as part of the meal.

**2 — Vessels:** Estimated diameters and areas:
- Rice plate: 23 cm → 415 cm²
- Meatball bowl: 17 cm → 227 cm²
- Vegetable bowl: 20 cm → 314 cm²
- Dessert plate: 18 cm → 254 cm²
- Drink: approximately 6 cm average internal diameter → 28 cm²

**3 — Items:** Rice; creamy curry with visible chunks, possibly chicken; four meatballs; carrots, corn, broccoli and other mixed vegetables; chocolate brownie; dark drink, assumed regular cola. No separate oil or dressing is clearly distinguishable.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Rice and curry are allocated separate areas to avoid double-counting.

| Item | Area covered | Area × average height = volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g → energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 35% | 145 × 1.6 = 232 ml | 0.8 → 186 g | 130 → 242 kcal |
| Creamy curry with chunks | 30% | 125 × 1.1 = 138 ml | 0.95 → 130 g | 150 → 195 kcal |
| Meatballs | 25% | 57 × 1.8 = 103 ml | 0.95 → 97 g | 250 → 243 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 45% | 141 × 1.8 = 254 ml | 0.6 → 153 g | 50 → 77 kcal |
| Brownie | 12% | 30 × 1.8 = 54 ml | 0.9 → 49 g | 430 → 211 kcal |
| Cola | Full liquid cross-section | 28 × 8.5 ≈ 240 ml | 1.0 → 240 g | 42 → 101 kcal |

Coverage check: rice and curry together cover approximately **65%** of their plate; the other dishes cover approximately **25%, 45%, and 12%** respectively.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **615 g of food**, plus **240 g of drink**, is plausible for the visible tray. Estimated total: **855 g and 1,070 kcal**. The largest uncertainties are the curry composition and whether the drink contains sugar.
